name: lodash
_comment: Fixture only. Not a real dependency, never installed. Trivy's node-pkg analyzer reads node_modules/*/package.json, so this manifest alone is enough to make an image carry a known-vulnerable library (GHSA-p6mc-m468-83gg, prototype pollution, HIGH, fixed in 4.17.19). Used by scripts/__tests__/scan-image.test.sh to prove that a LIBRARY finding is reported but does not block the gate.
